dedupe_keys.name: railsem19 dataset for semantic rail scene understanding 8 500 annotated images

description: RailSem19 offers 8,500 unique images taken from the ego-perspective of rail vehicles (trains and trams), with extensive semantic annotations: geometry-based labels (rail-relevant polygons and all rails as polylines) and dense label maps with many Cityscapes-compatible road labels. Many frames show where road and rail vehicles meet, such as railway crossings and trams on city streets. The page says the dataset is supplied to the scientific community for free under usage and licence terms bundled with the release, that all WildDash users can download it, and that no benchmark or public ranking is provided for it. Coverage: rail scenes from many countries. Format and access: image and annotation download for registered users. Licence and cost: free, with bundled terms. Caveats: no evaluation server, and the provider page does not name the institution. It supports digital twin and hazard detection work such as obstacle and track recognition for rail. It relates to OpenRailwayMap in the catalogue.
